service.description: The pay grades the caller reads (the shared ones and those owned by an employer in scope; with organizationPartyId, an employer in scope, the ones its positions take: its own and the shared ones), by name, searched by name or id ignoring case (or the one payGradeId names), paged (an export up to 2000): each its name, owner and comments, and whether the caller may change it, for any staff reader. For a holder of PAYROLL_VIEW also the band in effect on asOfDate (else the next one: dates, currency, frequency, minimum, reference and maximum), the count of bands, whether the caller may change it, its revision and, for the grade payGradeId names, every band, newest first (bands); amountsShown says which. Without PAYROLL_VIEW no band, amount, currency or frequency is in the answer. Refuses a caller who reads no employer (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

parameter.name: payGrades
parameter.description: payGradeId, gradeName, comments, organizationPartyId, organizationName (empty for a shared grade), amountsShown, canEdit; with PAYROLL_VIEW bandCount, band (fromDate, fromDateText, thruDateText, currencyUomId, timePeriodTypeId, frequencyText, minAmount, amount, maxAmount, state, stateText) and revision

parameter.name: bands
parameter.description: Every band of the grade payGradeId names, for PAYROLL_VIEW

service.description: A new pay grade (gradeName, comments, and its owner organizationPartyId, an employer in scope, or none for a grade shared by every employer), or a grade's new name or comments at the revision read, and with the band fields a new band from fromDate (now when empty) to an optional end: the band in effect then ends on that date and the new one starts, both kept; no employment salary is changed. A band needs a currency, a pay frequency (a Payroll time period type) and a minimum, reference (amount, F4) and maximum, the minimum at most the reference and the reference at most the maximum. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), an owner outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), a new or changed shared grade without PEOPLE_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS (PERMISSION_DENIED), no name (NAME_REQUIRED), a missing grade or another employer's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), another owner (OWNER_CHANGE), a revision other than the one read (REVISION_CHANGED), no or an unknown currency (CURRENCY_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_INVALID), no or another frequency (FREQUENCY_REQUIRED, FREQUENCY_INVALID), a missing, negative or too fine amount (AMOUNT_REQUIRED, AMOUNT_INVALID, CURRENCY_PRECISION), amounts out of order (BAND_ORDER), an end on or before the start (DATES_INVALID) and a band from that date or later already set (BAND_SCHEDULED).

The pay components of the employers the caller reads (or organizationPartyId, an employer in scope), searched by code or name ignoring case (term), of a kind, in a state on asOfDate (draft, current, future or ended; ended ones only when asked), paged (an export up to 2000): each its code, name, kind, employer, and the term in effect (else the next, else the draft): basis, calculation, unit, dates and state. With payrollComponentId, the component (its revision, the draft term's id), every term newest first (formula, declared inputs, dependencies, currency or unit, rounding stage, payslip visibility, account mapping, who published it) and the examples of the term asked for (payrollComponentTermId, else the draft, else the one in effect). Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and another employer's component (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A new pay component of an employer in scope (componentCode, a name a formula may use, unique in the employer; componentName; componentKindEnumId: earning, deduction, employer contribution or statistical), or a component's new name, description or end (end, componentThruDate) at the revision read; and with any term field its draft term: created from fromDate (now when empty) when it has none, else changed (payrollComponentTermId names it). A term is a fixed amount or a formula (the framework's decimal expression over the declared inputNames and the codes of the components it reads, which become its dependencies), in its currency (required for money: no implicit currency) or a statistical value's unit, with an optional rounding stage (places and direction), payslip visibility and its account mapping (an earning's expense account, a deduction's liability account, a contribution's both, a statistical value's none). A fixed amount says whether a pay run prorates it by the period fraction in a part period (prorated Y or N; when not given, yes for an earning, a deduction and an employer contribution, which recur each period, no for a statistical value; a formula prorates by reading periodFraction, and a one-off amount is an adjustment, never prorated: the user's call of Nov 12, 2026, impl-people P25 review). Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PAYROLL_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED, ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED), another employer's component (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), and CODE_REQUIRED, CODE_INVALID, CODE_TAKEN, NAME_REQUIRED, KIND_INVALID, COMPONENT_ENDED, COMPONENT_IN_USE, TERM_PUBLISHED (a published term is never changed), BASIS_REQUIRED, BASIS_INVALID, AMOUNT_REQUIRED, AMOUNT_INVALID, FORMULA_REQUIRED, FORMULA_INVALID (the evaluator's message, position and code), CYCLIC_DEPENDENCY (the formula reads the component itself), INPUT_INVALID, CURRENCY_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_INVALID, CURRENCY_PRECISION, UNIT_REQUIRED, UNIT_INVALID, ROUNDING_INVALID, STATISTICAL_NO_POSTING, ACCOUNT_NOT_FOR_KIND, ACCOUNT_INVALID (not one of the employer's), PAYEE_NOT_FOR_KIND (a payee for an earning or a statistical value), PAYEE_INVALID (no party, or the employer) and DATES_INVALID.

parameter.name: prorated
parameter.description: A fixed amount's proration in a part period: Y or N

parameter.name: payeePartyId
parameter.description: A deduction's or an employer contribution's payee (People P27 review): its amounts are one invoice from it a liability account at finalization

service.description: A named example of a component's draft term (payrollComponentTermId, else the draft): added, changed (payrollComponentExampleId) or removed (remove), at the component's revision. inputValues gives each name the formula reads a decimal ("name = value" pairs, a JSON object or a map); expectedAmount is what the term must give. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PAYROLL_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's component (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), no draft (NO_DRAFT), a published term (TERM_PUBLISHED), no name (NAME_REQUIRED), a value that is not a name and a decimal (VALUE_INVALID) and no or a bad amount (AMOUNT_REQUIRED, AMOUNT_INVALID).

A component's term (payrollComponentTermId, else the draft, else the one in effect) computed for each of its examples beside the amount expected (actual amount, whether it matches, the explanation: the formula with the values read and its rounding, or the evaluator's refusal such as a missing input), whether all pass, and, with inputValues, the amount those values give. A statistical component is shown with no total it enters (inTotals false). Reads and computes only. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's component (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), no term (NO_TERM) and unreadable values (VALUE_INVALID).

A component's draft term asked to be published from its date (or fromDate, which the term then takes), with a reason, at the revision read: checked as it would be published, then a People approval of kind PakPayrollConfig asked for it (its approvers notified on PeoplePayrollConfigApproval; never one who drafted it or asks). It is published on approval (decide#Publication), when the published term in effect then ends on that date. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PAYROLL_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's component (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), an ended component (COMPONENT_ENDED), no draft (NO_DRAFT, TERM_PUBLISHED), no reason (REASON_REQUIRED), the term's own refusals (store#Component's), a mapping its kind needs (MAPPING_REQUIRED), no example (EXAMPLES_REQUIRED), an example not giving its amount (EXAMPLE_FAILED, each named), a component it reads with no published term on that date (MISSING_DEPENDENCY), components reading each other (CYCLIC_DEPENDENCY, the cycle named), a published term starting on or after that date (TERMS_OVERLAP), ending a published term in the past (EFFECTIVE_DATE_PAST) and a request for the draft as it is waiting already (APPROVAL_PENDING). The dependency rules are checked on that date and on each later date the employer's published terms start or end before the term ends.

parameter.name: published
parameter.description: false: the term is published on approval

service.description: A decision of the waiting request to publish a component's draft term (payrollComponentId, else payrollComponentTermId's) or a structure's draft lines (payrollStructureId), by an approver of its step who reads the employer's payroll configuration (PAYROLL_VIEW): approve, or refuse with a reason, through PeopleApprovalServices.record#Decision at the revision asked (sourceRevision, from the notice). The last approval publishes the draft, checked again as publish#Component or publish#Structure checks it (a term's date that has passed with a term in effect then, or a structure's, becomes the approval's); a refusal leaves the draft as it is. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's record (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), no draft (NO_DRAFT), one who drafted it or asked to publish it (SELF_APPROVAL), anyone else not an approver of the step (NOT_APPROVER), a draft changed since it was asked (SOURCE_CHANGED), a refusal with no reason (REASON_REQUIRED), and the publishing checks' own refusals, when the decision is not recorded.

The PeoplePayrollConfigApproval topic's approve service (approve#NotificationMessage calls it as the user): decide#Publication approve at the term or structure and revision in the message; refuses a notice of another record (SOURCE_INVALID).

The PeoplePayrollConfigApproval topic's refuse service (refuse#NotificationMessage calls it as the user, with the reason): decide#Publication refuse at the term or structure and revision in the message; refuses a notice of another record (SOURCE_INVALID).

The pay structures of the employers the caller reads (or organizationPartyId, an employer in scope), searched by name ignoring case, in a state (draft, current, future or ended; ended ones only when asked), paged: each its employer, currency, pay basis, state, dates, the count of its components on asOfDate and of the pay assignments in effect then (assignmentCount, P23). With payrollStructureId, the structure (its revision) and its lines in payslip order (component, kind, dates, state, parameter values, eligibility, the term it calculates with), with the calculation order of its components on that date and the findings that block one (a dependency the structure lacks, a cycle, no term). Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and another employer's structure (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A new pay structure of an employer in scope (structureName, currencyUomId: required, never assumed, payBasisEnumId), a copy of one (copyFromStructureId: a new structure of the same employer with the source's current lines as drafts and no assignments), or a structure's new name, pay basis, description or currency (a draft's only) or its end (end, thruDate, reason), at the revision read. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PAYROLL_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED, ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED), another employer's structure (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), NAME_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_INVALID, CURRENCY_LOCKED (a published structure's), BASIS_INVALID, EMPLOYER_CHANGE (a copy for another employer), STRUCTURE_ENDED and STILL_ASSIGNED (an end while pay assignments use it then, P23).

A component added to a structure as a draft line (payrollComponentId: one of the employer's in use; one draft line of a component at a time), a draft line's dates, payslip order (sequenceNum) or parameter values (the structure's values of the component's declared inputs, "name = value" pairs) or eligibility (eligibilityEnumId, P23: PleAll, every assignment, or PleElected, an assignment that elects it) changed, a draft line removed (remove), or a published line ended (end, thruDate, reason: its only change), at the structure's revision. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PAYROLL_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's structure or line (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), STRUCTURE_ENDED, COMPONENT_REQUIRED, COMPONENT_UNAVAILABLE, LINE_EXISTS, LINE_PUBLISHED, ORDER_INVALID, VALUE_INVALID and DATES_INVALID.

A sample gross to net of a structure on asOfDate, its draft lines and its components' draft terms included so it is seen before it is published: each component computed in dependency order from the sample inputValues, the structure's parameter values and the results it reads, rounded by its own stage, with its explanation or what blocks it (a missing input, a dependency the structure lacks, a cycle, another currency); results in payslip order beside the calculation order; totals (gross, deductions, employer contributions, the localization's employee and employer items, net, the net rounded to the currency with the difference, employer cost; a statistical value enters none); the items of the localization chosen (payrollLocalizationId, else the group's), computed by its registered service; and the findings (complete when none blocks). With payrollGroupId, the group's periods a year are the input periodsPerYear. Reads and computes only: no record is written and no money is created. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's structure or group (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a group of another employer (EMPLOYER_CHANGE), an unknown localization (LOCALIZATION_INVALID) and unreadable values (VALUE_INVALID).

A structure's draft lines asked to be published, each from its own date or the publishing date (fromDate, now when empty), with a reason, at the revision read: checked as they would be published, then a People approval of kind PakPayrollConfig asked for them; they are published on approval (decide#Publication), the first publish starting the structure. Publishing reassigns no employee and rewrites no payslip. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PAYROLL_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's structure (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), STRUCTURE_ENDED, no reason (REASON_REQUIRED), no draft line (NO_DRAFT), a line's component with no published term on its start (COMPONENT_NOT_PUBLISHED), a money component in another currency (CURRENCY_MISMATCH), two lines of one component at once (TERMS_OVERLAP), no component on the date (LINES_REQUIRED), a dependency the structure lacks (MISSING_DEPENDENCY), components reading each other (CYCLIC_DEPENDENCY) and a request for the structure as it is waiting already (APPROVAL_PENDING). The term and dependency rules are checked on that date and on each later date a line, or a term of a line's component, starts or ends.

parameter.name: published
parameter.description: false: the lines are published on approval

service.description: The pay groups of the employers the caller reads (or organizationPartyId, an employer in scope), by name (ended ones with includeEnded), paged: each its employer, currency, frequency, first period, periods a year, pay-date policy, proration, time basis, workweek zone, localization and readiness (preview only in this build, with its reason: NO_LOCALIZATION, PREVIEW_ONLY for the demonstration, COVERAGE_MISSING or PROJECTION_PENDING; P27: LIVE_AVAILABLE or LIVE with liveAllowed for a real localization covering today, which no group of this build has), the localization binding, its revision and whether the caller may change it. With payrollGroupId, its prepared periods (dates, pay date, state). Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and another employer's group (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A new pay group of an employer in scope, or a group's changes (or its end) at the revision read, its policy fields audited with the reason. Nothing is assumed: currencyUomId, timePeriodTypeId (a Payroll month, semi-month, bi-week or week), firstPeriodFromDate (yyyy-MM-dd), periodsPerYear (the annual divisor), payDateOffsetDays (days after a period's last day, -31 to 62), prorationEnumId and timeBasisEnumId are required; workweekTimeZone and the localization binding are optional. Once periods are prepared the currency, frequency and first period stay. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PAYROLL_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED, ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED), another employer's group (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), live pay where the group's readiness does not allow it (LIVE_NOT_AVAILABLE: a real localization covering today and Accounting's payroll-origin projection are needed, impl-people P27; no group can be live in this build, whose one localization is the demonstration; P28: a group in external processing needs no localization, only the projection), a localization payee that is no party (PAYEE_INVALID) or an account that is none (ACCOUNT_INVALID), GROUP_ENDED, NAME_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_INVALID, FREQUENCY_REQUIRED, FREQUENCY_INVALID, FIRST_PERIOD_REQUIRED, DIVISOR_REQUIRED, DIVISOR_INVALID, PAY_DATE_REQUIRED, PAY_DATE_INVALID, PRORATION_REQUIRED, TIME_BASIS_REQUIRED, LOCALIZATION_INVALID, ZONE_INVALID, POLICY_LOCKED and STILL_ASSIGNED (an end while pay assignments use it then, P23).

parameter.name: externalProcessing
parameter.description: Y: an external processor calculates the group's pay (P28: its inputs exported and its results imported in the payroll exchange; never calculated here; live with no localization once Accounting's payroll-origin projection is in place)

service.description: The overpayment recovery settings of the payroll reader's employers (PAYROLL_VIEW; organizationPartyId one of them, ORGANIZATION_DENIED for another): each its recovery deduction, the cap a period (an amount, a percentage of net pay: of the employee's wage net on their latest finalized regular run, or both: the percentage at most the amount, the amount before a first net; capText says which), its deductions to choose from and the revision a change names; canEdit for a holder of PAYROLL_EDIT and PAYROLL_CONFIGURE (impl-people P27 review and P28, the user's calls of Nov 13, 2026).

An employer's overpayment recovery settings changed at the revision read (PartySettings PayrollRecoveryComponent, PayrollRecoveryCap and PayrollRecoveryCapPercent, audited): the recovery deduction, and the cap a period as an amount (capAmount), a percentage of net pay (capPercent, above 0 and at most 100), or both (the percentage of the last finalized net applies, at most the amount; before the employee's first net pay the amount applies: the user's call of Nov 13, 2026, impl-people P28); an empty value clears it. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PAYROLL_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED, ORGANIZATION_DENIED), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), a component that is not one of the employer's deductions (COMPONENT_INVALID) and a cap that is not a positive number or a percentage above 100 (CAP_INVALID).

A pay group's next periodCount periods (1 to 24), after the last prepared one or from its first period's start: each Mantle's TimePeriod of the employer and the group's frequency (create#TimePeriod: made once, shared by the employer's groups of that frequency) with the group's pay date (the period's last day plus its offset). Idempotent: a period prepared already is answered as it is (created false). With preview, the same periods are answered and nothing is written, for a payroll reader. No period is closed. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (a preview) or without PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT and PAYROLL_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's group (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), an ended group (GROUP_ENDED) and a count outside 1 to 24 (COUNT_INVALID).

The pay assignments of the employments current on asOfDate (now when empty) at the employers the caller reads (or organizationPartyId, an employer in scope), found by the person's name ignoring case (term), filtered by pay group, structure or readiness (ready, attention or unassigned), paged: each employment with its primary assignment in effect (else the next one), its structure, pay basis, group and dates, its salary and pay rate references, and its readiness (NO_ASSIGNMENT, STRUCTURE_NOT_IN_EFFECT, GROUP_ENDED, SALARY_MISSING, RATE_MISSING, CURRENCY_MISMATCH, PROFILE_MISSING, PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, else ready for a preview run). With partyRelationshipId, that employment (any dates) and every assignment it has had (history: structure, group, kind, dates, inputs, elected lines, state, revision, canEnd). Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), another employer's employment (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) and an unknown filter (FILTER_INVALID).

Employments put on a pay structure and a pay group from fromDate (today when empty) through thruDate (open when empty): those named (partyRelationshipIds, or one partyRelationshipId; at most 500), each in its own transaction under the employment's lock, a refusal named by its code and the rest going on: EMPLOYMENT_OUTSIDE (not the structure's employer's, or outside the scope), DATE_OUTSIDE (not employed then), PRIMARY_OVERLAP (another primary assignment then: one per employment and date across every group; with replaceCurrent and a reason, the one in effect on the date is ended there instead), STRUCTURE_ASSIGNED (a secondary assignment, isPrimary false, beside the same structure). inputValues are the employment's values of inputs the structure's components declare ("name = value" pairs; INPUT_UNKNOWN, and INPUT_INVALID for a name that is one of the employer's component codes); electedComponentIds the components of the structure's elective lines it takes (ELECTION_INVALID). Assigning changes no salary or rate. With operationKey, a retry answers the rows assigned already as repeated; with preview, the rows and their outcome, nothing written. Or with end, the assignment payrollAssignmentId ended from thruDate (today when empty, never in the past) at its revision (expectedRevision), with reason. Needs PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); another employer's structure, group or assignment is RECORD_UNAVAILABLE. Refuses: EMPLOYER_CHANGE (the group and structure of two employers), CURRENCY_MISMATCH, DATES_INVALID, STRUCTURE_NOT_PUBLISHED (not published and in effect on the date), GROUP_ENDED, VALUE_INVALID, REASON_REQUIRED, EMPLOYMENT_REQUIRED, TOO_MANY, REVISION_CHANGED, ASSIGNMENT_ENDED and EFFECTIVE_DATE_PAST.

parameter.name: partyRelationshipIds
parameter.description: A list, or ids separated by commas

parameter.name: rows
parameter.description: partyRelationshipId, partyId, personName, outcome (ready, done, repeated, refused), outcomeText, reasonCode, message, payrollAssignmentId

service.description: An employment's restricted payroll setup (design §8 PayAssignments' TaxAndBenefits): its tax profile for a registered localization (payrollLocalizationId) from fromDate (today when empty), the values of the fields that localization declares alone (profileValues: a map, a JSON object or "name = value" pairs; FIELD_UNKNOWN for any other, FIELD_REQUIRED for a required one missing, VALUE_INVALID for a value of the wrong kind), at the profile's revision (expectedRevision): the profile in effect ends on the date (audited with the reason); a later one set already is PROFILE_SCHEDULED. Or, with benefitTypeId, a benefit (Mantle's EmploymentBenefit) from fromDate with its cost and the employer's share in percent (BENEFIT_EXISTS when it overlaps one of the type, PERCENT_INVALID, AMOUNT_INVALID), or with endBenefit the benefit from benefitFromDate ended from thruDate (BENEFIT_ENDED), each at the benefits' revision (expectedRevision: get#Compensation's benefitRevision; P23 review). Bank details are not here: they change through Accounting's payment-method services. Employment's and Employee's historical tax fields are neither read nor written. Needs PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); another employer's employment is RECORD_UNAVAILABLE. Refuses also LOCALIZATION_INVALID, NO_FIELDS, REVISION_CHANGED, DATES_INVALID and DATE_OUTSIDE.

parameter.name: benefitFromDate
parameter.description: The benefit's start: a date and time, or its milliseconds

service.description: A person's compensation as a payroll reader of their employer reads it (design §4 Employee360's Compensation), for one employment (partyRelationshipId, else the current one at an employer in scope, then the newest): the salaries, newest first, the one in effect apart (amount, currency, frequency, grade, dates, state), the pay rates in effect, the pay assignments and the primary one in effect (or next), the benefits, the tax profile of the primary group's localization (or payrollLocalizationId's) with its declared fields and values, the bank account references masked, the pay changes waiting for approval, the readiness, canEdit (PAYROLL_EDIT) and payRevision (the salary revision a pay change names). Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED) and a person with no employment at an employer in scope, or an employment not theirs there (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), alike.
